steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); window.__gitgood.store.set((s) => ({ changes: { ...s.changes, summary: 'Update app value' } })); await window.__gitgood.actions.reviewChangesBeforeCommit(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.precommitReview.running && s.precommitReview.run) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const run = s.precommitReview.run; const base = __REPO_PATH__ + '/.git/gitgood/review/'; const exists = (p) => window.__gitgood.invoke('app.pathExists', p); return JSON.stringify({ runId: run ? run.id : null, findingCount: run ? run.findings.filter((f) => !f.dismissed).length : 0, latestJson: await exists(base + 'latest.json'), latestMd: await exists(base + 'latest.md'), runJson: run ? await exists(base + 'runs/' + run.id + '.json') : false, available: window.__gitgood.actions.agentHandoffAvailable(run), hasButton: !!document.querySelector('.fix-with-agent'), exportPath: run ? await window.__gitgood.invoke('ai.review.exportPath', __REPO_PATH__, run.id) : null, noticeShown: s.settings.ai.agentHandoffNoticeShown }); })()

(async () => { const before = window.__gitgood.store.get().precommitReview.run.id; await window.__gitgood.actions.handleProtocolReviewRerun({ repoPath: __REPO_PATH__ }); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.precommitReview.running && s.precommitReview.run && s.precommitReview.run.id !== before) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const run = s.precommitReview.run; const latest = await window.__gitgood.invoke('ai.review.latest', __REPO_PATH__); const base = __REPO_PATH__ + '/.git/gitgood/review/'; const exists = (p) => window.__gitgood.invoke('app.pathExists', p); return JSON.stringify({ changed: !!run && run.id !== before, latestMatches: !!latest && !!run && latest.id === run.id, oldRunJson: await exists(base + 'runs/' + before + '.json'), newRunJson: run ? await exists(base + 'runs/' + run.id + '.json') : false, findingCount: run ? run.findings.filter((f) => !f.dismissed).length : 0 }); })()

(async () => { const n = window.__gitgood.store.get().toasts.length; await window.__gitgood.actions.handleProtocolReviewRerun({ repoPath: '/nonexistent/repo' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const toasts = window.__gitgood.store.get().toasts; return JSON.stringify({ toastAdded: toasts.length > n, title: toasts.length ? toasts[toasts.length - 1].title : null, stillNotRunning: !window.__gitgood.store.get().precommitReview.running }); })()

(async () => { const run = window.__gitgood.store.get().precommitReview.run; window.__gitgood.actions.fixWithAgent(run); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const d = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: d ? d.kind : null, title: d ? d.title : null }); })()

(async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.__gitgood.store.set({ dialog: null }); const ai = window.__gitgood.store.get().settings.ai; await window.__gitgood.actions.updateSettings({ ai: { ...ai, agentCommand: 'custom', agentCustomCommand: '' } }); window.__gitgood.store.set({ dialog: { kind: 'settings', tab: 'ai' } }); await sleep(400); const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.field label')).find((l) => l.textContent === 'Command'); const input = label && label.parentElement.querySelector('input'); if (!input) return JSON.stringify({ error: 'no Command input' }); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const type = (v) => { set.call(input, v); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; type('aider --fix'); await sleep(400); const afterInvalid = window.__gitgood.store.get().settings.ai.agentCustomCommand; const errorText = (label.parentElement.querySelector('.error') || {}).textContent || null; type('aider --file {file}'); await sleep(400); const afterValid = window.__gitgood.store.get().settings.ai.agentCustomCommand; return JSON.stringify({ afterInvalid, errorText, afterValid }); })()
